description: Variation of condition 02 of Ref: 26/01325/HOU to allow a gable roof over the proposed side extension.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning from the date of the decision notice of the planning permission 26/01325/HOU issued on 21 May 2026Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. Location Plan AJC-1619-01 Dated 27.05.2026;Existing Ground & First Floor Plans AJC-1619-02 Dated 27.05.2026;Existing Second Floor & Roof Plans AJC-1619-03 Dated 27.05.2026;Existing Elevations AJC-1619-06 Dated 27.05.2026;Existing & Proposed Sections AJC-1619-08 Dated 27.05.2026;Existing & Proposed Site Plans AJC-1619-09 Dated 27.05.2026;Proposed Ground & First Floor Plans AJC-1619-04 Dated 27.05.2026;Proposed Second Floor & Roof Plans AJC-1619-05 Dated 27.05.2026;	Proposed Elevations AJC-1619-07 Dated 27.05.2026;Design & Access Statement;			Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external finishes shall be in materials to match those of the exterior of the existing buildings unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority in writing.  Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
The first floor side gable windows shall be fitted with obscure glazing and shall be retained as such for the duration of the development hereby permitted.Reason: To safeguard residential amenity.
